text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, where a computer can identify what is in a picture, such as a cat or a house. Another task is object detection, which means finding and locating multiple objects in one image. These technologies have many useful applications in daily life. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to see the road, recognise traffic signs, and detect pedestrians. Hospitals also use it to study medical images. As technology improves, computer vision will become even more important in our world.
